caption: Right after signup the assistant described our company from the email domain alone and warned that chats may be shared with third parties.
Searching our own domain returned one company record under Net New, with a Save button. Our avatar initials are hidden.
Saving that record paid out 50 onboarding credits at once. The company showed as saved and in no sequences. Our avatar initials are hidden.
A search for a second domain returned 0 results, so a small site can be missing from the database. Our avatar initials are hidden.
Add-ons step on the Basic monthly plan: $65 a seat, or $49 on annual. Inbound shows a 14-day trial and costs $149 a month on Essentials afterwards.
The payment step says you will not be charged until the review step. A badge in the card field is hidden.
